verdict.rationale: Jeeves publishes a hosted API reference at tryjeeves.redocly.app/apis that documents endpoints such as POST /v1/cards/transactions and the Boleto API, along with auth (mTLS/OAuth 2.0) and webhook guides. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes for a public OpenAPI spec at common paths all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
